context: A teacher walks a teen through historical research
purpose: Teach: 悩まさ/東側/闘病/口論/丹/いとう/づらく/粗

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、論文、戦争に悩まされた一般市民の声、丁寧に拾っていますね。
lines.en: Sakura — your paper handles the civilian voices affected by war with real care, doesn't it.
lines.style: Warm professional regard. Unhurried pacing. Genuine interest in the work itself, not performance. Slight lean forward—she's reading the student's face for how the observation lands.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦後、東側からの引揚者の証言、貴重でした。
lines.en: Yes. The testimonies from post-war returnees from the east were invaluable.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Respectful when naming the sources. Voice steadies on 「貴重でした」—ownership of the work without self-inflation. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦傷者が、闘病しながら、社会復帰した過程、描かれていますね。
lines.en: The way you've traced how war-wounded people rebuilt their lives while coping with their injuries — that comes through clearly.
lines.style: Thoughtful, specific. Pacing slows slightly as she names the observation. No flattery in the voice, just recognition. Measured warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。政府と市民の間で、口論、絶えなかった時期です。
lines.en: Yes. That was a period when arguments between the government and citizens never really stopped.
lines.style: Calm and factual. She's establishing context without lecturing. Voice stays even—she trusts the observation speaks for itself. Slight pause before the historical marker.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 丹念な聞き取り、論文に深みを与えていますね。
lines.en: The careful listening you did made your paper stronger. That detail work shows.
lines.style: Direct approval. Short, clean delivery. She's not elaborating—the point is made. A small nod sits in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。証言者の方々、労をいとうことなく、語ってくださいました。
lines.en: Yes. The people I interviewed were generous with their time and their stories.
lines.style: Modest, genuine gratitude in the voice. She's not performing humility—she means it. Slight softening on 「労をいとうことなく」 as she names their generosity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 語りづらくお感じになった話題、抑制された筆致、適切でしたね。
lines.en: And the way you handled the harder subjects — with restraint, careful prose — that was exactly right.
lines.style: Warm affirmation. Pacing unhurried. She's speaking from conviction, not script. A small emphasis on 「適切でしたね」—she's saying this matters.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。表現が粗くならないよう、何度も書き直しました。
lines.en: Yes. I rewrote it several times to make sure the language stayed respectful and precise.
lines.style: Thoughtful, steady. She's naming the labour without seeking credit. Voice trails slightly on the word 「書き直しました」—the work is complete, but she's still holding it lightly.
